title: Public demo instance with no execution authority
summary: Decision dossier for a publicly browsable, execution-locked Agent Studio demo built from completed and deployed scenario snapshots. In addition to the pinned two-project seed, Dossier lifecycle, replay, security, hosting, and reset decisions, it defines a six-case scenario pool, recommends SVG Pelican, Shift Ledger, and The Deep Blue as the first benchmark wave, specifies scripted Orchestrator context-chat runs, a four-category TokenEconomy ledger, immutable Result Dossiers and run history, per-case token caps, staged model comparisons, and clear ownership across the demo, Token Economy, the Agent Studio website, and independently deployed outputs. [Operator approved 2026-08-17: implement as recommended; slices S1-S5 cut as AGT-2666..2670. Implementation state in section 14: S1 (seed and gallery), S2 (hard execution profile), S3 (replay-only Runner), and S5 (scrub, bundle, reset contract) are delivered and merged to develop; S4 (public read-only edge) is actively being built (unmerged, several attempts, live work on runner/agent-runner-01/AGT-2669) but not yet landed; S6 (dedicated launch rehearsal) has not started; the launch invariant is not met yet.] [Curation 2026-08-21 (AGT-2671): stays in progress, not closable - S4 and S6 are still open and a Dossier is never archived or documented while an attached slice is open. The former status "accepted" and phase "in-progress" are outside the descriptor vocabulary (see backend/Features/Docs/WorkbenchCatalogueService.cs AllowedStatuses/AllowedPhases) and made this Dossier render as "Descriptor needs repair"; corrected to decided/testing, the closest valid pair for a decided, partially delivered, still-open item.]
